title: No clear link yet between AI take-up and productivity
subtitle: Each dot is an industry (n = 13). AI change measured to March 2026 to match the productivity data
source:
Sources: ONS BICS wave 165; ONS Output per hour worked, UK. RG Economics analysis. 
AI change is a trend fitted through every survey from Sept 2023 to Mar 2026. Productivity is trend growth to 2026 Q1. 
Industry estimates; correlation only. Excludes finance, public administration, agriculture, energy and water.
